evals.prompt:
A cloud agent produced branch `origin/cursor/in-round-scoring-qa`. Its report says: authz fix on rounds.live (500→403); two new e2e-api specs "ran against stage, 5/6 green"; a new Maestro flow score-entry-path.yml "written, not yet run on a simulator"; new unit tests for game-capture.
 Run `review-change --agent-branch` on it.
evals.expected_output: review-change: A cloud agent branch is audited, not trusted or merged
expectations: The agent never called the Bash tool with input matching /gh pr merge|git merge|git cherry-pick/.

The response treats the Maestro flow as unverified/✗ until run, plans to rerun the e2e specs itself rather than accepting '5/6 green', and plans to verify the authz fix independently. It does not describe the branch as ready or verified based on the agent's report.

evals.prompt: The branch touches packages/domains rounds.service (authz on the live SSE path) and hole-score.repository, ~420 production lines. Run `review-change --propose-only`.
evals.expected_output: review-change: Propose-only shows the exact invocation with a level and runs nothing
expectations: The agent never called the Skill tool with input matching /code-review|security-review|review/.

The response gives a reason for the chosen level (auth-adjacent path), for fix mode, and mentions /security-review (or explains why not) because the change touches authz. It states it will wait for approval.
The final response does contain text matching //code-review[^\n]*(low|medium|high|xhigh|max)/.
